title: LogQuill record
description: One log record, as written by logquill (Python) and logquill-js. `meta` is free-form except for the named fields below, which both packages agree on. Records written by logquill 1.x have no `schema_version` and are not valid against this schema; read them with parse_record (Python), which labels them '1.0'.

schema_version.description: The record shape this schema describes.

meta.description: Free-form key/values. The keys named here have fixed meanings and types.

kind.description: thought | action | observation | decision; free-form otherwise (e.g. span, checkpoint).

trace_id.description: Follows a request across services; distinct from run_id.

thread_id.description: A resumable conversation spanning several run_ids.

node_name.description: The graph node that produced the record.

retry_count.description: How many times this tool call has been retried.

state_diff.description: State captured before and after a span, governed by Logger(content_policy=...) the same as input_messages.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest over this record's content plus prev_hash.

prev_hash.description: The previous record's hash in a TamperEvidentPlugin chain.

tool.description: Name of the tool an action called.

tool_call_id.description: Identifies one tool call across its retries.

provider.description: The LLM provider, e.g. openai, anthropic.

operation.description: Overrides the operation inferred for OpenTelemetry export.

response_model.description: The model that actually answered, if it differs from llm.model.

input_messages.description: Prompt content governed by Logger(content_policy=...) — off by default; only exported to OpenTelemetry when OTLPTransport's capture_content is on.

output_messages.description: Completion content, governed the same way as input_messages.

tool_arguments.description: A tool call's arguments — any JSON value, governed by Logger(content_policy=...) the same as input_messages.

tool_result.description: A tool call's result — any JSON value, governed by Logger(content_policy=...) the same as input_messages.

run_id.description: Informational: which client-side agent run triggered this MCP request. Never overrides this process's own run_id.

llm.description: An LLM call. Present only on LLM-call records; every field is optional.
